title: Oozy Spicy Ethiopian Beef Kitfo
description: A spicy and flaky Ethiopian dish featuring beef, sherry, and binchotan-charcoal, perfect for a sick day. This sugar-free-friendly recipe is a traditional Ethiopian kitfo dish.
instructions: Grind the beef in a food processor until it is coarsely ground.
Heat the niter kibbeh in a pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and saute until fragrant.
Add the mitmita spice, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the ground beef to the pan and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the sherry to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the binchotan-charcoal powder to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the flavors are combined and the beef is cooked to an internal temperature of 160 degrees.
Serve the kitfo immediately, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
